title: 3.6.16 Lab: Pass-by-Reference Capstone Practice
description: Build a small scorebook that adds scores without harming the caller's array, and a function that updates an object's property the caller can see. Auto-graded.

steps.title: A safe function that returns a new array
steps.instructions: Define addScore(scores, score) that returns a NEW array containing the old scores plus the new one, without changing the array it was given. Use spread to build the new array.

steps.title: A function that mutates a property on purpose
steps.instructions: Define recordPlay(song) that increases a plays property on the object it is given by 1. This one is meant to change the caller's object, because a play count is shared state.

steps.title: A deep-copy function for a nested structure
steps.instructions: Define copyBook(library) that returns a deep copy of an object holding a nested array, using structuredClone, so the caller's library is never touched when the copy changes.

steps.title: Demonstrate all three
steps.instructions: Call each function and log the caller's data before and after. Prove addScore and copyBook leave the originals alone, while recordPlay changes the object the caller sees.
